claim_boundary.claim_if_null: The Stage 9 Noetic readout may remain valid, but static output-embedding sonar did not establish token-level involution opposition under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Pythia-160M's Stage 9 Noetic readout directions show token-level opposition for the formal Noetic involution pairs, exceeding random-direction controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, 40-Element hard-partner resolution, Noetic clusters, raw CAS-symbol understanding, free-form generation control, or cross-model generality from Stage 28A.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 28A tests Noetic classes collapsed from the 40-Element fixture. It does not test Noetic clusters, component-localized Noetic covers, or dynamic generation.

formal_anchor: TKS/Noetic involution structure: ^2<->^3, ^5<->^6, and ^8<->^9 are treated as typed opposition pairs. The sonar asks whether Pythia's output embedding geometry reflects that opposition.

gates.criterion: Stage 9 activation artifact matches the preregistered local replacement contract used by Stage 24B.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Noetic probe test accuracy is at least 0.50 on the 10-way collapsed Noetic task.
gates.name: probe_floor

gates.criterion: Readable top-token rate is at least 0.50.
gates.name: readable_signature_floor

gates.criterion: non-involution mean cosine minus involution mean cosine is positive.
gates.name: involution_opposition_margin

gates.criterion: Involution-opposition margin exceeds random-direction controls with empirical p < 0.05.
gates.name: random_direction_control

gates.criterion: At least 2 of 3 involution pairs fall below the global pairwise median cosine similarity.
gates.name: pair_rank_floor

method: Collapse the Stage 9 40-Element labels into 10 Noetic labels (^1..^9,^0).
Fit the locked focus-token layer-5 Noetic probe on the existing Stage 9 activation artifact.
Project the 10 Noetic probe directions through Pythia-160M output embeddings.
Center and normalize each Noetic token-signature vector.
Measure whether involution pairs (^2/^3, ^5/^6, ^8/^9) have lower cosine similarity / higher opposition than non-involution Noetic pairs.
Compare the involution-opposition margin against random-direction controls.
Report top positive and negative readable tokens for each Noetic class for audit, but do not use human interpretation as the pass gate.
motivation: Foundation hard-partner token sonar failed because same-drive/different-register classes share vocabulary. Stage 28A tests the sharper hypothesis: Noetic involution pairs are formal opposites and should therefore be more separable/opposed in static token-signature space.

required_inputs.task: 10-way Noetic readout collapsed from the Stage 9 original-TKS 40 Element fixture
